comment: Controlled tagging vocabulary for the Paperless projection (dotfiles#136). This file is the authority for stable slugs; Paperless numeric tag IDs are only a projection of it. AI writes only into ai-candidate/*; humans accept by retagging into the owning namespace, and sync-tags exports accepted tags to durable sidecars.

namespaces.kind: document genre; owned by the file/academic catalogs
namespaces.course: academic/course context; owned by the academic catalog
namespaces.status: reading workflow state; human-owned in Paperless
namespaces.source: provenance of the canonical file; machine-owned
namespaces.ai-candidate: proposed classifications awaiting human review; machine-owned
